name: ppcor
method_summary: ppcor implements fast matrix-based partial and semi-partial correlation calculations with p-values and test statistics. This integration mirrors ppcor::pcor(), which computes a signed pairwise partial-correlation matrix for every gene pair while controlling for all other genes.

threading.upstream_mapping: The selected ppcor::pcor() entrypoint exposes no documented thread, worker, core, scheduler or process-level sharding control. The wrapper requires ANDREA --threads=1 and pins common BLAS/OpenMP environment variables to 1; any BLAS-level parallelism is not a safe user-mapped upstream control.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions expression columns by group before running ppcor independently per group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one ppcor child run per group; each child calls the same ppcor::pcor() entrypoint on that group's expression matrix.

progress.note: ppcor::pcor() is a synchronous R function that returns a complete result list and exposes no stable progress callback, counter or incremental output. The wrapper can only report coarse lifecycle states.

method.description: Correlation coefficient used by ppcor::pcor before partial-correlation calculation. Upstream default is pearson.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined wrapper and R session lifecycle log.
Raw signed partial-correlation coefficient matrix returned as ppcor::pcor(x)$estimate.
Raw p-value matrix returned as ppcor::pcor(x)$p.value; entries may be missing when upstream cannot provide p-values for singular high-dimensional inputs.
Raw test-statistic matrix returned as ppcor::pcor(x)$statistic; entries may be missing when upstream cannot provide statistics for singular high-dimensional inputs.
Resolved ppcor parameters, upstream package version, expression dimensions and runtime resource mapping.
